optimized_sql:
SELECT preagg.d_year, preagg.brand_id, preagg.brand, preagg.sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT dt.d_year, item_816.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item_816.i_brand AS brand, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id = 816) AS item_816
    JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item_816.i_item_sk
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 11) AS dt ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY dt.d_year, item_816.i_brand, item_816.i_brand_id
) AS preagg
ORDER BY preagg.d_year, preagg.sum_agg DESC, preagg.brand_id
LIMIT 100
